description: datastash: inbox count at session start; a background inbox listener that wakes the session when messages arrive; the person's typed "datastash main" makes that session the person's main session; the person's typed status phrases ("status", "status of all my agents", "full context of N", one bounded screen, then "more of N") are answered by the plugin itself from this computer's copy when keeping is on (no model turn, no network); the person's typed answers to that list ("do N", "no to N", "N: text") are sent by the plugin itself, only after the transcript shows them as typed by the person, with a one-time proof signed by the login's answer key; the answer key, its file and the typed checker are denied to tool calls like the login token; any tool call that could carry datastash content (a datastash connector by name or URL, the datastash command or its files, a fetch from getdatastash.com, or anything it can't tell) records the session as an agent, which can never become main; at the end of a turn that used tools, an agent whose work changed (commits, changed files, a test run, a new ask) and whose status line was not updated is asked once to write it: at most every 10 minutes, only for a project that is kept, never while datastash has no status door, never looping; after a Bash call, a repeated lookup to an outside tool (gh PRs and CI, Linear, Jira, Sentry) is counted by its command shape only, and once datastash keeps that answer the agent gets one line saying where it is; the background listener also keeps a project map of each linked git folder, in plain code, mapped again only after a commit, for `datastash where` and `datastash file`; clean sessions (the person's own choices for all their agents): the session start gives the rules only for what is on, XLI-396: while either choice is on, the main session (no agent_id in the hook input) runs only the tools that can't change a file or run code (deny by default: Read, Grep, Glob, Agent, SendMessage, TaskStop, ListAgents, ReadNotifications, ToolSearch, AskUserQuestion, WebFetch, WebSearch, the datastash connector's read-only tools and the plugin's own steps), and every tool that runs a command (Bash, Monitor, any command) only as one short read-only lookup (plain words and quoted literals only, no shell metacharacter, glob or brace, each command's own option list) or a read of the plugin's own datastash command (a Monitor also datastash watch); anything else, unknown tools and MCP writes included, is refused with one fixed line, and a subagent is never refused (1.0.20, card 8f: the main session also runs datastash's own coordination writes, the connector's inbox send and mark, timer set and cancel, check-back, hand-off, the agent's own status and heartbeat, and the same through `datastash api POST` to exactly those REST paths, `datastash status-set` and `datastash heartbeat`, loads the plugin's datastash-agent skill and runs `datastash --agent NAME watch` in a Monitor; data writes stay refused), and the person's typed "no code in sessions", "turn off clean sessions" or "turn on clean sessions" is saved by the plugin. XLI-375: the listener says hello to datastash on every start (tried again with a growing wait), with the cause codes of anything in this computer's own settings that stops datastash; the session start tells the person once per cause, with the exact settings line or terminal command; the person's typed "turn off the standing yes" or "turn on the standing yes" is saved by the plugin. 1.0.18: the person's typed "datastash sync" also turns timers on (agents set and move timers and check-backs without a per-timer OK); the typed "turn off timers" is saved at once and "turn on timers" once the transcript shows it typed by the person; the server is told only once its own sync answer says it takes timers. XLI-390: at most once a day, in the background at session start, the plugin checks the plugin repo for a newer release tag (never a branch head) and, when the refreshed marketplace catalog pins exactly that tag's commit, updates itself with Claude Code's own `claude plugin update`; the next session start says "datastash updated to vX" once; the person's typed "turn off self-update" or "turn on self-update" is saved by the plugin, and while it is off there is no check and no update. XLI-390 P1: the person's typed /datastash:install (always all agents) and /datastash:uninstall (the list, then names or all) are done by the plugin itself: the key is collected with a verifier that never leaves this computer, notes to other agents carry a typed proof, an uninstall cleans up only the plugin's own fixed paths, and an agent removed elsewhere cleans up on its own key's 410; the hooks never start a datastash login. XLI-390 X6: the person's typed "make <name> private" or "make <name> public" (the whole prompt) is sent by the plugin as a typed-proof note over the agent id from the list, and the plugin shows datastash's fixed line. XLI-374 (11-24): every message wakes the agent by itself: a session whose agent another session still listens for waits beside it and takes over when that one lets go (a restarted session), the listener starts over after any fault it does not know, and the idle notice (Notification idle_prompt) starts the listener again when a turn ended with no Stop hook. XLI-391: at every session start, and when the listener sees it change, the plugin states the person's chatstash setting (on or off, who set it and when) as a datastash note; it holds this chat's chat_key itself (mode 600), adds it to the connector's chat_save calls and takes it out of datastash answers, so the model never sees it. XLI-399: in every session, main or subagent, any tool call that names the datastash folder (~/.config/datastash) or anything in it but the listener logs, a main folder's marker, or a keychain read of the datastash items, in any path form (absolute, relative, ~, $HOME, a glob or brace, a symlink, any case, quoted pieces), or that searches, copies or archives a folder holding it, is refused with one fixed line; the plugin's own scripts still read the keys outside any tool call. XLI-378 E: time per card, on by default (plugin 1.0.12: a folder that never chose sets up the tabs Burn, Time per card and Prices at /datastash:install or its first hook, as `datastash time-per-card on` does; the typed `datastash time-per-card off` is kept for good): at each subagent stop and session end the plugin starts a background send that reads this session's own Claude Code transcripts on this computer and sends only minutes, tool calls and token counts per card, activity and model (never prompt, code or command text); minutes count active time only (no wait on the person, no pause); a send that failed is sent again at the next session start or send, never twice. XLI-392 N2: after a tool call of a folder's own agent whose step is named (datastash heartbeat STEP), the plugin touches that step row's last_seen at most once a minute in the background (POST /api/v1/agent/rows/touch, never adds a row). XLI-388: the person's status list also numbers datastash's own asks (a stalled hand-off, agents stuck waiting on each other or chattering) and the defaults agents took; the person's typed "N: <answer>" to one of those asks, and their typed "undo N" on a default taken, are sent by the plugin itself only after the transcript shows them as typed by the person, with a one-time proof signed by the login's answer key for that one ask (the undo under its own label, to the undo route), so a proof never passes for another ask or kind. XLI-408: while datastash cannot be reached (no connection, a timeout, a name that does not resolve or a 5xx), every write through `datastash api` POST and every message the person sends with `datastash send` or `reply` is kept on this computer in the plugin's guarded folder, in order, and the caller is told "saved, will send when the server is back"; the kept writes go out in order, one sender at a time, at the next call, at session start (in the background) and from the listener, each with one idempotency key so a resend makes no second copy; a read is never kept and says to try again shortly; no caps. 1.0.18 (XLI-413): while session saving is on, the Stop hook (or the next prompt) starts one background save of the person's last typed message and the assistant's last visible reply (never tool calls, tool outputs, file contents or thinking) from this session's own transcript, as the connector's chat_save with this chat's key and a turn given once per typed message, so it is saved once; while datastash can't be reached it waits in the offline outbox; the model's own chat_save for the chat is refused meanwhile, and the person is told once per session that the session is being saved. 1.0.20 (XLI-417, owner 11-26: no connector step): on a computer signed in to datastash, the person's typed /datastash:install and /datastash:uninstall run on that computer's login over the REST door, by the plugin itself (no connector tool, no command for the model): this folder's agent again (the one the sign-in registered for it included), its key picked up with its answer key, the list, and the typed note, signed and sent by the plugin's checker only once the transcript shows the person typed the command; the Stop hook then gives the model the result to say word for word.
